limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: Three advertised mixer commands always fail.
The issue was reported today against current main.
Reporter supplied exact logs and code locations; application validation reply is pending.
Each command must reach a backend using one documented parameter contract.
The key mismatch is unconditional and visible in source; reporter reproduced it live.
evidence: Dispatcher emits index/volume while channels require incompatible keys

dimensions.reason: The patch aligns three small paths and adds master strip lookup.
Production build and routing tests are automated; final AX mutation needs Logic Pro.
Public track/value contract is preserved and master avoids an invented OSC address.
Repository merged several fixes in the last month.
The fix restores core DAW mixer automation for all MCP clients.
Canonical parameters prevent both OSC and Accessibility failures.
evidence: One contract shared by dispatcher and channels

dimensions.reason: The same contract tests make future mixer command drift easier to catch.
